title: World War II
description: Explore the deadliest conflict in human history, from the invasion of Poland to the fall of Berlin and the atomic bombings of Japan.

title: World War I
description: A journey through the First World War - the trenches, alliances, revolutions, and battles that reshaped the modern world.

title: Russian Civil War
description: Follow the multi-sided civil war that tore apart the former Russian Empire after the revolutions of 1917.

title: Spanish Civil War
description: Explore the war between Republicans and Nationalists in Spain from 1936 to 1939, a brutal prelude to World War II.

title: Winter War
description: Trace Finland's 1939-1940 struggle against the Soviet Union, from the invasion to the Moscow Peace Treaty.

title: Continuation War
description: Follow Finland's 1941-1944 war against the Soviet Union, from renewed fighting to the Moscow Armistice.

title: 1948 Arab-Israeli War
description: Follow Israel's War of Independence, from the struggle for Jerusalem and the Arab invasion to the campaigns that secured the new state.

title: Korean War
description: Explore the rapid invasions, desperate defenses, amphibious landings, and international intervention that divided Korea.

title: Vietnam War
description: Trace the long war in Vietnam through its major campaigns, political turning points, and the experience of American intervention.

title: Suez Crisis
description: Follow the 1956 struggle over the Suez Canal involving Egypt, Israel, Britain, and France.

title: Laotian Civil War
description: Explore the hidden Cold War fought across Laos by local factions, regional powers, and covert American forces.

title: Cambodian Civil War
description: Trace Cambodia’s descent into civil war, foreign intervention, and the rise of the Khmer Rouge.

title: Six-Day War
description: Follow Israel’s decisive 1967 campaign across the Sinai, Jerusalem, the West Bank, and the Golan Heights.

title: War of Attrition
description: Explore the prolonged artillery, commando, and air war fought mainly along the Suez Canal after 1967.

title: Yom Kippur War
description: Explore Israel’s fight to recover from the surprise attacks of October 1973 on the Sinai and Golan fronts.

title: Chadian-Libyan War
description: Explore the Chadian-Libyan War from the Aouzou Strip dispute through French intervention and the mobile Toyota War campaign that forced Libya out of Chad.

title: Iran-Iraq War
description: Follow eight years of invasion, urban battles, attrition, tanker attacks, and direct American naval involvement.

title: 1982 Lebanon War
description: Explore Israel’s 1982 campaign against the PLO, its battles with Syria, and the difficult aftermath in Lebanon.

title: Falklands War
description: Follow the 1982 Falklands War from Argentina's seizure of the islands through Britain's long-range air, naval, amphibious, and ground campaign.

title: Finnish Civil War
description: Explore Finnish Civil War through its origins, major turning points, international dimension, human cost, and lasting consequences. The Russian Revolution destroyed imperial authority in Finland just as the country declared independence.

title: Estonian War of Independence
description: Explore Estonia's fight for independence against Soviet forces, Baltic German formations, and the wider turmoil left by the Russian Civil War.

title: Lithuanian-Soviet War
description: Follow Lithuania's 1918-1919 war against Soviet forces through the collapse of empire, battles around Kaunas and Alytus, German support, and the defense of independence.

title: Polish-Lithuanian War
description: Trace the Polish-Lithuanian War through the dispute over Vilnius, Sejny and Suwałki, the Polish-Soviet War overlap, Żeligowski's mutiny, and the frozen diplomatic rupture.

title: Turkish War of Independence
description: Explore Turkish War of Independence through its origins, major turning points, international dimension, human cost, and lasting consequences. World War I ended with the Ottoman Empire defeated and Allied powers planning its partition.

title: Lapland War
description: Trace Finland's 1944-1945 war to expel German forces from the Arctic north after the Moscow Armistice ended the Continuation War.

title: Indonesian National Revolution
description: Explore Indonesian National Revolution through its origins, major turning points, international dimension, human cost, and lasting consequences. World War II shattered Dutch colonial control and ended with Japan's sudden surrender.

title: Indochina Wars
description: Explore Indochina Wars through its origins, major turning points, international dimension, human cost, and lasting consequences. World War II weakened France and destroyed the old colonial order in Indochina.

title: Croatian War of Independence
description: Follow Croatia's break from Yugoslavia through early clashes, sieges, UN diplomacy, Croatian offensives, displacement, and the war's contested legacy.

title: Croat-Bosniak War
description: Trace the Croat-Bosniak War from the collapse of alliance politics in Bosnia to massacres, Mostar, international pressure, and the Washington Agreement.

title: Kosovo War
description: Explore Kosovo's road from lost autonomy and insurgency to massacres, NATO intervention, displacement, UN administration, and disputed independence.

title: Transnistria War
description: Trace the Transnistria War from Soviet collapse and language politics through Dubăsari, Bender, Russian 14th Army intervention, ceasefire, and the frozen conflict.

title: War in Abkhazia
description: Follow the War in Abkhazia through Georgia's 1992 entry, Gagra, Tkvarcheli, Gumista, Sukhumi, ethnic cleansing, Russian involvement, and the unresolved separatist legacy.

title: Tajikistani Civil War
description: Explore the Tajikistani Civil War through regional factionalism, Dushanbe street politics, southern fighting, Afghan-border spillover, Russian involvement, UN mediation, and the 1997 peace.

title: First Chechen War
description: Explore First Chechen War through its origins, major turning points, international dimension, human cost, and lasting consequences. The Russian Empire's violent history in the Caucasus and the Soviet collapse encouraged Chechen separatism.

title: War of Dagestan
description: Explore War of Dagestan through its origins, major turning points, international dimension, human cost, and lasting consequences. The unresolved First Chechen War left armed Islamist factions operating from Chechnya.

title: Second Chechen War
description: Explore Second Chechen War through its origins, major turning points, international dimension, human cost, and lasting consequences. The Dagestan incursion gave Moscow the immediate reason to invade Chechnya again.

title: South Lebanon Conflict
description: Explore South Lebanon Conflict through its origins, major turning points, international dimension, human cost, and lasting consequences. Israel's 1982 invasion removed the PLO leadership from Beirut but did not end violence in Lebanon.

title: Gulf War
description: Explore Gulf War through its origins, major turning points, international dimension, human cost, and lasting consequences. The Iran-Iraq War left Iraq militarized, indebted, and economically strained.

title: War on Terror
description: Explore War on Terror through its origins, major turning points, international dimension, human cost, and lasting consequences. The Gulf War expanded the long-term American military presence in the Middle East, which became one grievance used by transnational jihadist groups.

title: War in Afghanistan
description: Explore War in Afghanistan through its origins, major turning points, international dimension, human cost, and lasting consequences. The first major campaign of the War on Terror targeted al-Qaeda and the Taliban government that sheltered it.

title: Iran-Israel Proxy Conflict
description: Explore Iran-Israel Proxy Conflict through its origins, major turning points, international dimension, human cost, and lasting consequences. The South Lebanon conflict strengthened Hezbollah and tied it closely to Iran's regional strategy.

title: Second Intifada
description: Follow Israel's struggle against the suicide bombings and armed attacks of the Second Intifada, from the collapse of negotiations to the 2005 ceasefire.

title: 2006 Lebanon War
description: Explore Israel's 2006 war against Hezbollah after a cross-border raid, from the rocket campaign to UN Security Council Resolution 1701.

title: Gaza War (2008-2009)
description: Follow Operation Cast Lead, Israel's campaign to reduce Hamas rocket fire and weapons smuggling from Gaza.

title: 2012 Gaza War
description: Trace Operation Pillar of Defense, the eight-day confrontation that tested Iron Dome and ended through Egyptian mediation.

title: 2014 Gaza War
description: Explore Operation Protective Edge, from rocket fire and tunnel warfare to a ceasefire after fifty days.

title: 2021 Israel-Palestine Crisis
description: Follow Operation Guardian of the Walls, from Jerusalem unrest and Hamas rocket fire to Israel's campaign against Gaza tunnel networks.

title: Israel-Hamas War
description: Trace the war that began with Hamas's October 7 attack, Israel's campaign in Gaza, hostage operations, and the fragile ceasefire through June 2026.

title: Twelve-Day War
description: Explore Israel's June 2025 campaign against Iran's nuclear and missile programs and Iran's direct missile retaliation.

title: 2026 Lebanon War
description: Follow the renewed Israel-Hezbollah war that began in March 2026 and remains ongoing alongside the wider Iran conflict.

title: 2026 Iran War
description: Explore the ongoing 2026 war in which Israel and the United States struck Iran and Iran launched a regional missile campaign.

title: Polish-Soviet War
description: Follow the struggle that decided Poland's eastern frontier and halted the Soviet advance toward central Europe.

title: Irish War of Independence
description: Trace the guerrilla war, British counterinsurgency, and negotiations that created the Irish Free State.

title: Greek Civil War
description: Explore the first major Cold War civil conflict, from wartime resistance divisions to the communist defeat in 1949.

title: Algerian War
description: Follow Algeria's war of independence and the political crisis that transformed France.

title: First Intifada
description: Trace the Palestinian uprising that transformed Israeli-Palestinian politics and helped lead to the Oslo Accords.

title: Bosnian War
description: Explore the siege, ethnic cleansing, international intervention, and diplomacy that defined the Bosnian War.

title: Iraq War
description: Follow the US-led invasion, occupation, insurgency, sectarian war, surge, and withdrawal from Iraq.

title: Russo-Georgian War
description: Trace the 2008 Russo-Georgian War through South Ossetian escalation, Tskhinvali, Russian intervention, attacks on Gori and Poti, ceasefire diplomacy, recognition, and occupation.

title: Russo-Ukrainian War
description: Follow Russia's war against Ukraine from Crimea and Donbas in 2014 through the ongoing full-scale invasion.

title: Syrian Civil War
description: Trace Syria's uprising, civil war, foreign interventions, fight against ISIS, and the fall of Assad.

title: Soviet-Afghan War
description: Follow the Soviet intervention, Afghan resistance, Western support, and withdrawal that reshaped the late Cold War.

title: Yugoslav Wars
description: Trace Yugoslavia's violent breakup, ethnic cleansing, Western intervention, and the creation of successor states.

title: First Libyan Civil War
description: Explore Libya's 2011 uprising, NATO intervention, the fall of Tripoli, Gaddafi's death, and the unresolved security vacuum after victory.

title: Lebanese Civil War
description: Follow Lebanon's civil war, foreign interventions, the PLO's armed presence, and Hezbollah's emergence.

title: Palestinian Fedayeen Insurgency
description: Trace the border raids, Israeli reprisals, and regional escalation that preceded the Suez Crisis.

title: Operation Litani
description: Examine Israel's 1978 campaign against PLO bases in southern Lebanon and the creation of UNIFIL.

title: Israel-Hezbollah War, 2023-2024
description: Trace Hezbollah's post-October 7 attacks, Israel's campaign, and the fragile 2024 ceasefire.

title: Israeli Operation in Syria, 2024-Present
description: Examine Israel's security operations in Syria after Assad's fall and the contested struggle over the border.
